title: Escaping Parameter Space: Tight Generalization Bounds via Representation Quality
abstract: arXiv:2610.23729v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural networks based on their last hidden layer representations. By evaluating representation quality with a parameter-free $k$-nearest-neighbor ($k$-NN) classifier, our certificate avoids traditional parameter-space complexity measures, KL divergences to a posterior, weight norms, and compression. The bound is tight: trained from scratch, it reaches an 8.0 percentage point gap to test error on CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18) and yields the first non-vacuous certificates we are aware of on CIFAR-100; with frozen DINOv2 representations, it certifies at 1.4\% on CIFAR-10 and 23.1\% on 1,000-class ImageNet. It decomposes additively into three empirical, independently measurable quantities: local class geometry ($k$-NN decoder error), decoder-network agreement, and training stability. This allows the bound to act as a diagnostic too

translated_title: 逃离参数空间：基于表征质量的紧致泛化界
translated_abstract: 我们为确定性神经网络推导了一个基于其最后隐藏层表征的紧致泛化界。通过使用无参数的k近邻（k-NN）分类器来评估表征质量，我们的证书避免了传统的参数空间复杂度度量、与后验分布的KL散度、权重范数以及压缩方法。该界非常紧致：从头训练时，在CIFAR-10（ResNet-18）上与测试误差仅相差8.0个百分点，并且据我们所知首次在CIFAR-100上给出了非空洞的证书；使用冻结的DINOv2表征时，该界在CIFAR-10上的认证误差为1.4%，在1000类ImageNet上为23.1%。该界可加性地分解为三个可独立测量的经验量：局部类别几何结构（k-NN解码器误差）、解码器与网络的一致性，以及训练稳定性。这使得该界还可以作为一种诊断工具使用。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于最后隐藏层表征质量的紧致泛化界，通过无参数k-NN分类器评估表征质量，摆脱了传统参数空间复杂度度量，在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上实现了迄今最紧致的泛化认证。
